reviews.text: Nico is professional and works hard. Flexibel and had a spot quickly. Very happy with the result!

reviews.name: Tania
reviews.text: Nico assembled my bike quickly and professionally. Highly recommended!

reviews.name: Irvan
reviews.text:
The handyman arrived right on time and was neat and polite.
He assembled our cabinet well, including the door we had trouble with, and also moved the lamp neatly like a true professional.
We were actually unable to manage these tasks ourselves. It is a pity that we had to pay more for moving the lamp, but fair is fair. It did indeed involve extra work. All in all, I was quite satisfied, and I will definitely keep him in mind for any future jobs.
